title: Madhu Malati
desc: Malati, a rich landowner's daughter, and Debi, a simpleton, fall for Madhu, a popular man. However, he sees Debi as his friend and falls for Malati whose father has her betrothed to Rajesh, a thug.

title: Suorani Duorani
desc: The king of Kishangarh marries a girl, unaware that she is a demoness. Upon learning the truth about his stepmother, the prince decides to save his father and their kingdom from her evil plans.

title: Barkane
desc: Sandip, an unemployed man, refuses a politician's offer to kill Tribeni, his rival. When Tribeni learns about this, she falls in love with him and offers dowry to his father.

title: Agnipath
desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.

title: Bandie
desc: Unable to conceive an heir, Maharaja Brajbhan and his wife are forced to abdicate the throne for his cousin, Vikram. Chaos ensues when Vikram learns that the queen is pregnant and decides to kill her.

title: Chocolate
desc: A small-time thief steals a cop's precious ring, sparking a relentless pursuit.

desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Thai Curry
desc: Three friends decide to go on a fun trip to Thailand. However, their journey takes a troubled turn when they become entangled with a mafia gang.

desc: Skilled artists and singers enchant audiences with popular Bengali devotional and folk songs, celebrating the rich musical heritage.

desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.
